Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The homepage still serves three "ADVERTISEMENT"-labelled gold-dealer ad blocks from the first-party /api/Banner endpoint; the site's older cosmetic rules no longer match the Next.js markup. The rule goldtraders.or.th#⁠#⁠div:⁠has(⁠> p.mt-2.text-center.text-sm.text-neutral-500) hides all three blocks (creatives and labels) and was verified in the AdGuard CLI proxy experiment with an intact page. ## Rule `goldtraders.or.th##div:has(> p.mt-2.text-center.text-sm.text-neutral-500)` ## Policy rationale The banners advertise other companies (YLG Bullion, NGG Trade, TDC Gold, Ausiris, InterGOLD, GT Gold), i.e. advertising rather than the site's own self-promotion, so the ad-blocking policy asks for a rule. No policy rule closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, not a scam/phishing page, and the run instruction states the agent never closes an issue. The reported defect was reproduced live, so a rule is the correct outcome rather than a close. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c2a42bbcdcd6914b37c7fe7b2d9fe154711b5583/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt) Under the heading `!
